content: tokio fan-out primitives (official docs): broadcast::channel(cap) = ring buffer, every receiver sees every value; slow receiver gets RecvError::Lagged(n) with n=dropped count and resumes at oldest retained - built-in lag DETECTION but data LOSS (ordered-stream corruption for terminal bytes unless Lagged triggers resync); mpsc per-client = bounded queue with natural backpressure, try_send Full = lag signal, pair with one writer task per WS conn; mpsc-per-client preferred for terminal fan-out (no silent loss, per-client memory bound, independent slow-client policy); broadcast acceptable if Lagged handler triggers full ring-buffer resync.
